question: Do bigger discounts go with lower profit margins?
method: Spearman rank correlation (Pearson r = -0.86 for comparison)
conclusion: Higher discounts go with lower margins (rho = -0.65, large effect); very unlikely to be chance (p < 0.001).

question: Does the chance of an order line losing money depend on the discount level?
method: Chi-square test of independence (3 degrees of freedom)
conclusion: Share of loss-making lines by discount - No discount: 0%, 1-20%: 14%, 21-40%: 90%, Over 40%: 100%. Association is large (V = 0.82); very unlikely to be chance (p < 0.001).

question: Do profit margins really differ between regions?
method: Kruskal-Wallis H test (ANOVA F = 260.2, p = 1.41e-162 for comparison)
conclusion: Median line margin % by region - West: 29.0, East: 28.0, South: 26.2, Central: 18.0. The differences are very unlikely to be chance (p < 0.001); effect size is small (epsilon-squared = 0.023).

question: Do Consumer, Corporate and Home Office orders differ in value?
method: Kruskal-Wallis H test (ANOVA F = 0.3, p = 0.761 for comparison)
conclusion: Median order value ($) by segment - Corporate: 158.3, Consumer: 154.7, Home Office: 142.3. The differences are possibly due to chance (p = 0.39); effect size is negligible (epsilon-squared = 0.000).

question: Is the Furniture margin really lower than the other categories?
method: Mann-Whitney U test (Welch t-test p = 2.66e-28 for comparison)
conclusion: Median line margin: Furniture 11.1% vs others 29.0% (lower); very unlikely to be chance (p < 0.001); effect is medium (r = -0.36).

question: Is monthly revenue really higher in Q4 (Oct-Dec) than in other months?
conclusion: Average Q4 month $73,173 vs other months $39,412; very unlikely to be chance (p < 0.001); large effect (d = 1.54).
